q: It's about time somebody sent me a tip for Thundercats. Such a classy little game, so fast, such marvy graphics, so pretty, so why no tips? Who knows, p'raps folks spend so much time noodling about wiv the game, they haven't got any time left to lift a pen and send me a letter.
Your reasoning, p’raps, was theological, / When apostolicum near ground to halt. / But I believe it quite illogical, / Nay – vestra culpa! – ’twas a grievous fault.
2005 April, Jill Mitchell with ‘Cardinall’ [Andrew] Carwood, “Trust Me, I’m the Conductor”, in Early Music Review, Huntingdon, Cambridgeshire: King’s Music, →ISSN, →OCLC, page 25, column 1:
